Meta recently updated its commercial terms of use, declaring that the company can “use any content from [a business account’s] domains, web pages, or URLs to provide, develop, improve, research, train, and maintain the integrity of” Meta products and services.

According to legal experts interviewed by Nieman Lab, this looked like a “remarkable provision” that could give Meta permission to scrape the website of any publisher with a Meta business account and use the content to train the company’s AI models. (While Meta defeated a high-profile lawsuit over alleged copyright infringement last year, other cases against AI companies, including Meta, continue.)
However, a Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web. And now, The Verge reports that the provision has been removed.

“We’ve heard you and want to clarify: the crawling terms we consolidated only applied to our ads and business products, and we’ve clarified that in the terms themselves,” the company said in a statement. “It does not change how Meta uses web crawlers.”

cards.title: RTX Spark Ignites Global Celebration as New Windows PCs Arrive
cards.title_cn: 随着新款Windows PC的到来， RTX Spark点燃了全球庆祝活动
cards.summary: 【NVIDIA】NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops are now available, bringing NVIDIA Blackwell RTX graphics, up to 128GB of unified memory and the full NVIDIA AI platform to slim, premium Windows PCs. Starting at $2,399, lapt…
fulltext: Share This Article
NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops are now available, bringing NVIDIA Blackwell RTX graphics, up to 128GB of unified memory and the full NVIDIA AI platform to slim, premium Windows PCs.
Starting at $2,399, laptops from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI bring powerful local AI, content creation and gaming capabilities to a portable device, with additional systems on the way.
NVIDIA celebrated the launch with events around the world, including one in Berlin, where NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang made a surprise appearance.

RTX Spark brings decades of NVIDIA accelerated computing innovation into a single superchip, combining an NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU and NVIDIA Grace CPU with up to 1 petaflop of AI compute and up to 128GB of unified memory. Read more in the press release.

The arrival of RTX Spark brought fans, creators and PC enthusiasts together in Berlin during the Festival of Lights, an annual autumn art festival that transforms the German capital’s most famous landmarks, streets and squares into glowing canvases. This year, the festival featured RTX Spark-themed lighting on the Berlin TV Tower.

Fans gathered hours ahead in anticipation for the launch celebration at XPERION, the gaming venue inside Saturn at Alexanderplatz, where attendees got hands-on with RTX Spark laptops from leading PC makers, exploring the latest gaming experiences, content-creation workflows and local AI capabilities.
The celebration included a special appearance by Huang, who greeted an enthusiastic crowd, passed out popcorn and posed for selfies. He also gave out five personally signed RTX Spark laptops.
Berlin held one of six RTX Spark retail launch celebrations worldwide.
A massive crowd gathered at the JD MALL Shuangjing Store in Beijing to celebrate the highly anticipated launch, enjoying a night of innovation and community connection.
Attendees at Vatan Bilgisayar Topkapı in Istanbul experienced a lively event filled with interactive demonstrations and specialized programming led by local creators.
Seoul’s COEX East Lobby transformed into a bustling hub of creativity, hosting an eager crowd for engaging hands-on demos and captivating evening sessions dedicated to gaming and AI.

Tech enthusiasts in San Francisco visited the local Best Buy store for an unforgettable morning of hands-on RTX Spark demos, fireside chats with local founders and a special appearance by tech influencer iJustine.
The energy at Muse Garden in Taipei was electric as the local AI community came together for a vibrant evening of music, engaging discussions and incredible product showcases.
Developers and AI enthusiasts can explore NVIDIA-tested recipes, playbooks and resources for running local AI on RTX Spark.
See notice regarding software product information.

cards.title_cn: 首席执行官表示， Replit使OpenAI成为Anthropic的默认值
cards.summary: 【OpenAI】Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.

Replit, the AI coding platform that has become a favorite of startup founders and developers, is no longer working with Anthropic, the company’s CEO and co-founder Amjad Masad said Thursday while onstage at TechCrunch Disrupt.

Masad said the decision was made for a number of different reasons, including cost. Replit announced a partnership with OpenAI in August, but there was never any indication that it was no longer partnering with Anthropic.

“I think ChatGPT is better now,” Masad said, adding that the company uses an internal benchmark to help assess metrics like performance. “We publish a public benchmark as well, and consistently, Sol and Astra perform better on building vibe-coded applications from scratch. It was a decision based on both cost, partnership, and performance. And for all these reasons, we just felt like they were a better partner for now.”

It seems, however, that Anthropic hasn’t been completely cut out of Replit, which sells a cloud-based software development platform where users can develop and deploy apps directly from inside their browser.

After Disrupt, Masad clarified that customers can still access Anthropic models on the platform, but that OpenAI’s ChatGPT is now the default. This shift could significantly reduce Replit’s spend with Anthropic since most customers stick with the default rather than selecting a model themselves.

Prior to striking a deal with OpenAI, Replit relied on Anthropic’s Claude models to run its platform. That partnership was said to have helped the company grow its revenue significantly, and Masad noted on stage that Replit had been, until recently, a top-five customer of Anthropic’s.

“Replit remains model agnostic,” Masad told TechCrunch over the weekend. “Our users can choose Anthropic’s Claude or other supported models…OpenAI is now our preferred partner for powering Replit Agent, based on performance, economics, and the strength of our partnership.”

Masad’s comments on stage were rejected by insiders familiar with the partnership between the Anthropic and Replit, however. One person familiar, who asked not to be named, said the partnership was still in place.

There is evidence on the company’s website, blog posts, and social media posts that Replit was promoting Anthropic products as recently as a few weeks ago. For instance, a blog post in late September cites Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5 and Claude Fable 5.1 as models running in Replit Agent’s production environment. Around the same time, one of Replit’s product employees posted on X about using Anthropic’s flagship model Opus 5.5 and promoting its capabilities.
Masad also shared insights about the company’s growth while onstage at Disrupt, noting that enterprise is starting to provide a larger slice of revenue.

“We’re not sharing ARR numbers just yet, but in terms of growth, like, I would say, enterprise was like 2% of revenue last year,” Masad said. “This year, I would say like 15% of our revenue is enterprise contracts, and more than 50% of our revenue is B2B.”
Backstage, Masad told TechCrunch that he expects more than half of Replit’s revenue to come from enterprise and government customers in 2027.
Masad also commented on the necessity for good AI safety measures.

“In the same way that us humans need a certain environment to work — you need a nice office, maybe nice good food in the office, air-conditioning, computer — agents need a habitat for them to exist and do good work,” he said. “So that habitat has good orchestration, good error recovery, good safety and security and sandboxing, good networking, good identity and authorization. And once you figure all of that out, then you can deploy AI safely.”

This article was originally published on October 16 at 2:22 pm PT. It has been updated to include more context around Replit’s partnerships with Anthropic and OpenAI. Its title has been updated, as well.

该公司首席执行官兼联合创始人阿姆贾德·马萨德（ Amjad Masad ）周四在TechCrunch Disrupt的舞台上表示，已成为初创公司创始人和开发人员最喜欢的人工智能编码平台Replit已不再与Anthropic合作。
马萨德说，做出这一决定有许多不同的原因，包括成本。Replit于8月宣布与OpenAI建立合作伙伴关系，但从未有任何迹象表明它不再与Anthropic合作。
“我认为ChatGPT现在更好了，”马萨德说，并补充说，该公司使用内部基准来帮助评估绩效指标。“我们也发布了一个公共基准，并且一贯地， Sol和Astra在从头开始构建氛围编码应用程序方面表现更好。这是一个基于成本、合作伙伴关系和绩效的决定。出于所有这些原因，我们觉得他们现在是一个更好的合作伙伴。”
然而，看起来Anthropic并没有完全脱离Replit ， Replit销售基于云的软件开发平台，用户可以直接从浏览器内部开发和部署应用程序。
中断后， Masad澄清说，客户仍然可以在平台上访问Anthropic模型，但OpenAI的ChatGPT现在是默认值。这种转变可以大大减少Replit在Anthropic上的支出，因为大多数客户坚持使用默认值，而不是自己选择模型。
在与OpenAI达成协议之前， Replit依靠Anthropic的Claude模型来运行其平台。据说这种伙伴关系帮助公司大幅增加了收入， Masad在舞台上指出，直到最近， Replit一直是Anthropic的前五大客户。
“Replit仍然是不可知的模型，”马萨德周末告诉TechCrunch。“我们的用户可以选择Anthropic的Claude或其他受支持的型号…… OpenAI现在是我们为Replit Agent提供支持的首选合作伙伴，这取决于我们的性能、经济和合作伙伴关系的实力。”
然而，熟悉Anthropic和Replit之间伙伴关系的内部人士拒绝了Masad在舞台上的评论。一位不愿透露姓名的熟人表示，合作伙伴关系仍然存在。

该公司的网站、博客帖子和社交媒体帖子有证据表明，就在几周前， Replit还在推广Anthropic产品。例如， 9月下旬的一篇博客文章引用了Anthropic的Claude Fable 5和Claude Fable 5.1作为Replit Agent生产环境中运行的模型。大约在同一时间， Replit的一名产品员工在X上发布了关于使用Anthropic的旗舰型号Opus 5.5并推广其功能的信息。
Masad还在Disrupt的舞台上分享了有关公司增长的见解，并指出企业开始提供更大的收入。
Masad说： “我们还没有分享ARR数字，但就增长而言，我想说，企业去年占收入的2%。” “今年，我想说的是，我们15%的收入是企业合同，超过50%的收入是B2B。”
在后台，马萨德告诉TechCrunch ，他预计2027年Replit一半以上的收入将来自企业和政府客户。
Masad还评论了采取良好的人工智能安全措施的必要性。
他说： “就像我们人类需要一定的工作环境一样--你需要一个漂亮的办公室，也许办公室里有很好的食物，空调，电脑--代理商需要一个栖息地，让他们生存并做好工作。” “因此，栖息地具有良好的协调、良好的错误恢复、良好的安全性和沙盒、良好的网络、良好的身份和授权。一旦你弄清楚了所有这些，你就可以安全地部署人工智能。”

cards.title: Meta’s new terms may allow it to train AI on news sites for free
cards.title_cn: Meta的新条款可能允许它免费在新闻网站上培训人工智能
cards.summary: 【Meta】Meta's new terms appear to give it permission to crawl and scrape websites "associated" with the businesses that use its platforms - including online publishers, according to a report from Nieman Lab.…
fulltext: The new policy allows Meta to crawl all websites ‘associated’ with a business account.

Meta’s new terms appear to give it permission to crawl and scrape websites “associated” with the businesses that use its platforms — including online publishers, according to a report from Nieman Lab. The new terms, which go into effect on October 30th, say Meta can use this outside content to “develop, improve, research,” and “train” its AI products.

While Meta spokesperson Daniel Roberts says that the company is just “consolidating” its commercial and self-serve ad terms, legal experts tell Nieman Lab that this could allow Meta “to argue its commercial terms supersede other blocking instructions,” like a site’s robots.txt file. That could potentially allow Meta to bypass a licensing agreement and freely train its AI models on content posted by online publishers.
The new policy applies to business accounts that promote their content across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger:

You authorize us (or any entity acting on our behalf) to use automated software (such as web scrapers, bots, robots, spiders, crawlers, and user agents) and create test credentials to access, index, cache, analyze, collect, retrieve, or crawl the domains, web pages, or URLs (and any content available through them) that are associated with your products or services, or that are made available through your or users’ use of Meta Company Products and services, and to periodically pull updates from such domains, web pages, or URLs. Meta may use any content from such domains, web pages, or URLs to provide, develop, improve, research, train, and maintain the integrity of, the Meta Company Products, services, and features provided under these Commercial Terms and any other applicable supplemental terms.

Roberts pushes back on Nieman Lab’s reporting, saying “There is no change to how Meta uses web crawlers; any suggestion to the contrary is false… Content owners can still use robots.txt flags to indicate their preferences, as we clearly explain in our developer documentation.” Meta has followed OpenAI in striking AI licensing deals with CNN, Fox News, USA Today, and People Inc., but these terms could give the company access to a much broader swath of content.

“For news publishers, this clearly represents permission to Meta to train AI on any content from their sites and possibly to deploy some of that content, even in competition with the publishers themselves,” James Grimmelmann, a professor of digital and information law at Cornell, tells Nieman Lab.

Andy Stone, Meta’s vice president of communications, writes in a post on X that this change isn’t meant to target news sites. “This update is designed to make sure we’re able to pull accurate information about products for sale on third-party websites when making on-platform ad and content recommendations, not about scraping news sites.”

Businesses that don’t agree to Meta’s new policies “may stop all access or use of our Products for business or commercial purposes,” the terms say. Last month, Meta launched a new Meta One subscription that requires businesses and creators to pay to include links in posts and reels. “Put another way, Meta has begun charging users to post links to the same content that it will be permitted to crawl for free,” Nieman Lab says.
Update, October 16th: Added a statement from Meta and legal commentary.

Update, October 17th: Meta has updated its terms and issued a new statement saying “the crawling terms we consolidated only applied to our ads and business products, and we’ve clarified that in the terms themselves.” More information can be found in this more recent article.

cards.summary_cn: 【Meta】根据Nieman Lab的一份报告， Meta的新条款似乎允许其抓取和抓取与使用其平台的企业（包括在线出版商） “相关”的网站。……
fulltext_cn: 新政策允许Meta抓取与公司账号“关联”的所有网站。
根据Nieman Lab的一份报告， Meta的新条款似乎允许其抓取和抓取与使用其平台的企业（包括在线出版商） “相关”的网站。新条款将于10月30日生效，称Meta可以利用这些外部内容“开发、改进、研究”和“培训”其人工智能产品。
虽然Meta发言人丹尼尔·罗伯茨（ Daniel Roberts ）表示，该公司只是在“整合”其商业和自助服务广告条款，但法律专家告诉尼曼实验室，这可能使Meta “争论其商业条款取代其他阻止指令” ，例如网站的robots.txt文件。这可能会允许Meta绕过许可协议，并在在线出版商发布的内容上自由训练其人工智能模型。
新政策适用于在Facebook、Instagram、WhatsApp和Messenger上推广其内容的公司账号：

您授权我们（或代表我们行事的任何实体）使用自动化软件（如网络爬虫、机器人、机器人、蜘蛛、爬虫和用户代理）并创建测试凭据，以访问、索引、缓存、分析、收集、检索或抓取与您的产品或服务相关联的域、网页或URL （以及通过它们提供的任何内容） ，或通过您或用户使用Meta Company产品和服务提供的域、网页或URL ，并定期从此类域、网页或URL中提取更新。Meta可以使用来自此类域、网页或URL的任何内容来提供、开发、改进、研究、培训和维护Meta公司根据这些商业条款和任何其他适用的补充条款提供的产品、服务和功能的完整性。

Roberts反驳了Nieman Lab的报道，他说： “Meta使用网络爬虫的方式没有任何变化；任何相反的建议都是错误的……内容所有者仍然可以使用robots.txt标记来表明他们的偏好，正如我们在开发人员文档中明确解释的那样。Meta跟随OpenAI与美国有线电视新闻网（ CNN ）、福克斯新闻（ Fox News ）、今日美国（ USA Today ）和People Inc.达成了人工智能许可协议，但这些条款可能会让该公司获得更广泛的内容。
康奈尔大学数字和信息法教授詹姆斯·格里梅尔曼（ James Grimmelmann ）告诉尼曼实验室： “对于新闻出版商来说，这显然意味着允许Meta对其网站上的任何内容进行人工智能培训，并可能部署其中的一些内容，即使在与出版商本身的竞争中也是如此。”
Meta的传播副总裁安迪·斯通（ Andy Stone ）在X上的一篇帖子中写道，这一变化并不是为了针对新闻网站。“此次更新旨在确保我们在制作平台上广告和内容推荐时，能够提取有关第三方网站上销售产品的准确信息，而不是关于抓取新闻网站的信息。”
条款规定，不同意Meta新政策的企业“可以停止出于商业或商业目的访问或使用我们的产品”。上个月， Meta推出了一项新的Meta One订阅，要求企业和创作者付费，以便在帖子和转轴中包含链接。Nieman Lab说： “换句话说， Meta已经开始向用户收取费用，让他们发布指向相同内容的链接，并允许他们免费抓取这些内容。”
更新， 10月16日：添加了Meta和法律评论的声明。
更新， 10月17日： Meta已更新其条款，并发布了一份新的声明，称“我们合并的抓取条款仅适用于我们的广告和商业产品，我们已在条款本身中对此进行了澄清。“您可以在这篇最新文章中找到更多信息。

cards.title: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
cards.title_cn: Meta删除了可能允许其抓取新闻网站的语言
cards.summary: 【Meta】After backlash, Meta is updating its terms again to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI. Specifically, the following language no lo…
fulltext: Language that experts say allowed the scraping of news sites to train its AI has been removed from Meta’s terms.

After backlash, Meta is updating its terms again to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI. Specifically, the following language no longer appears on the commercial terms page:

… Meta may use any content from such domains, web pages, or URLs to provide, develop, improve, research, train, and maintain the integrity of, the Meta Company Products, services, and features provided under these Commercial Terms and any other applicable supplemental terms.

Many, including Neiman Lab and James Grimmelmann, a professor of digital and information law at Cornell, interpreted it as an attempt to give Meta the right to use content scraped from sites to train its AI products for free and supersede blocking instructions in a site’s robots.txt file.

Andy Stone, Meta’s vice president of communications, and spokesperson Daniel Roberts pushed back, saying that “There is no change to how Meta uses web crawlers; any suggestion to the contrary is false.” Today’s update to its terms and a new statement go further, removing the controversial language entirely. Roberts said in a follow-up statement to The Verge this morning:

“We’ve heard you and want to clarify: the crawling terms we consolidated only applied to our ads and business products, and we’ve clarified that in the terms themselves. It does not change how Meta uses web crawlers. As always, content owners can use robots.txt to signal their preferences. This is not about scraping news sites, and these updates don’t give us new rights that supersede those preferences.”

在强烈反对之后， Meta再次更新其条款，以删除暗示它可以从包括新闻网站在内的网站上抓取内容来训练其人工智能的语言。具体而言，以下语言不再出现在商业条款页面上：
…… Meta可以使用此类域、网页或URL中的任何内容来提供、开发、改进、研究、培训和维护Meta公司根据这些商业条款和任何其他适用的补充条款提供的产品、服务和功能的完整性。
包括内曼实验室(Neiman Lab)和康奈尔大学(Cornell)数字和信息法教授詹姆斯·格里梅尔曼(James Grimmelmann)在内的许多人认为，这是为了让Meta有权免费使用从网站上抓取的内容来训练其人工智能产品，并取代网站robots.txt文件中的阻止指令。
Meta的传播副总裁安迪·斯通（ Andy Stone ）和发言人丹尼尔·罗伯茨（ Daniel Roberts ）反驳说： “Meta使用网络爬虫的方式没有变化；任何相反的建议都是错误的。“今天对其条款的更新和新声明更进一步，完全删除了有争议的语言。罗伯茨今天早上在给The Verge的后续声明中说：
“我们已经听取了您的意见，并希望澄清：我们合并的抓取条款仅适用于我们的广告和商业产品，我们已经在条款本身中对此进行了澄清。它不会改变Meta使用网络爬虫的方式。与往常一样，内容所有者可以使用robots.txt来表明他们的偏好。这与抓取新闻网站无关，这些更新并没有赋予我们取代这些偏好的新权利。”

fulltext: 10月17日，埃安轿跑Ray7正式开启预售，预售价12.88 万起。新车车长4.9米，轴距2.9米，车头部分搭配3.25米的超长双环灯带，是埃安10年焕新的家族式标识。
新车采用宁德时代电池以及广汽自研的弹匣电池2.0技术，能够在充分释放续航能力的同时，监控电池健康状态。提供45.58kWh和62.98kWh两种规格，续航可达702公里，整车风阻系数 Cd 低至 0.22。
Ray7搭载华为DriveONE多合一电驱，以及华为DriveONE芯片级驱制融合架构，百公里制动仅为32.8米。
底盘方面，Ray7搭载高性能前后稳定杆和后五连杆悬架，过弯极限更高，滤振更干净。
智能化上， Ray7搭载27颗车规级全视角传感器，采用文远知行L4级Robotaxi同源大模型。这帮助新车能够复用 L4 积累的海量场景经验，在城区掉头、绕行等复杂场景中可顺利通行。
自2025年广汽推进“番禺行动”以来，昊铂埃安BU的研发、生产、销售等环节效率不断提升，产品迭代和新车投放节奏明显加快。作为埃安全新Ray车系的首款新车，Ray7是埃安开启年轻化序列的关键落子，也是广汽切入20万级市场的重要布局。
这一细分市场竞争并不轻松：小鹏P7、极氪007等车型已经提前卡位。Ray7想在年轻人心中占位，不能只堆参数，更要把智能座舱与辅助驾驶、三电安全、补能效率、用车成本和价格权益上的差异，变成用户可感、可信、可持续的体验，这才是埃安年轻化的分水岭。（雷峰网(公众号：雷峰网)）

fulltext: IT之家 10 月 17 日消息，据 Wccftech 今日报道，华硕推出了旗下首款英特尔 Arc Pro B70 显卡，面向 AI 推理及工作站市场。华硕此前缺席了英特尔 Arc 独立显卡的多个世代，此次推出新品意味着其再次加入英特尔独立显卡产品阵营。
华硕这款产品名为 UGen Intel Arc Pro B70 32GB GDDR6，采用英特尔 Xe2 架构的 Big Battlemage GPU，配备 32GB GDDR6 ECC 显存、32 个 Xe 核心和 256 个 XMX AI 引擎，INT8 AI 算力最高可达 367 TOPS，典型板卡功耗 310W。
该卡采用双槽设计和涡轮式散热结构，配备 1 个 HDMI 接口和 3 个 DisplayPort 接口，使用 PCIe 5.0 x16 接口，显存带宽为 608GB/s。
华硕表示，该卡支持 vLLM、llama.cpp、Ollama、PyTorch、OpenVINO、oneAPI 和 Vulkan 等 AI 框架及工具。用户还可以通过多卡配置扩展显存容量，最多支持 4 张显卡协同工作，合计提供 128GB 显存，以运行更大规模的 AI 模型。
价格方面，华硕暂未在产品页面公布 UGen Intel Arc Pro B70 32GB 的具体售价。同类英特尔 Arc Pro B70 显卡的市场价格通常在 1,299 美元至 2,000 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 8,701 元至 13,397 元人民币）以上，具体价格取决于产品型号及销售渠道。
